pages.title: 6 Inch Silicone Blank Baby -  Daisey sculpted by Jodie Lombardo | MySweetLittleAngels

metadata.description:
Please welcome Daisey. She is an adorable 6 inch sculpt created completely by Jodie Lombardo. She is poured in ecoflex 20 and is so soft and cuddly. She comes in a choice of our usual colours - warm Caucasian, cool Caucasian and sweet chocolate brown.

Full price for this blank silicone baby is $200 Australian.

pages.title: Clown baby Chase sculpted by Bonnie Brown | MySweetLittleAngels

metadata.description:
How sweet is Clown Baby Chase! Measuring 19 inches and weighing 2.4 kgs, he is an adorable bundle of sweetness. Painted by me - Jodie Lombardo.  He is wearing a beautiful set custom made for him. He will also come with a cotton neck piece, and a custom-made mohair wig in either pink, purple or blue. Chase loves to be cuddled and you will find it hard to put him down. He is looking for a new mummy or daddy to adopt him. 
Afterpay is available for Australian customers, otherwise I except Square credit card payments or Paypal. 
Layaway is available on this sweet clown. 
All prices are shown in Australian dollars.

metadata.description: Tarquin is a sweet rabbit sculpted and poured by Jodie Lombardo. Tarquin measures 12.5 inches with bent legs or 13.5 with straight legs. He is poured in an eco20 soft blend and weighs 800 grams. Tarquin can be poured in either a light flesh color or in a white. Included pictures are indicative of what Tarquin can look like painted and rooted. The Tarquin you receive will be a blank, unpainted kit.Kits are poured on demand when payment is complete, so allow 4 weeks for order to be ready for delivery.Australian customers can purchase through the website. All international customers must email jodie.mysweetlittleangels@gmail.com for a paypal invoice.

pages.title: Reborn Clown Baby Twin A available for adoption. | MySweetLittleAngels

metadata.description:
Please welcome the adorable clown baby Twin A. Sculpted by Bonnie Brown and painted by Jodie Lombardo. Twin A's skin tone and hair has been painted with genesis heat set paint. Her clown makeup is IRHSP and she is sealed using the Irresistables gorgeous Dewy Skin glaze. She has a custom-made clown suit and a custom-made wig can be available upon request.
Full adoption price is $1600au ($1050us).
Layaway, payin4 and afterpay are all available for this bub. Please message me if you need more information.
